stem: An analyst tells the store director: "The variance of daily basket value is 400." Why is this hard to use, and what would be better?

options.text: Variance is in euros squared; say instead that the SD is €20
Variance is in percent; say instead that baskets vary by 400%
400 is too large for a variance; the query must contain an error
Variance needs the mean beside it; say €400 above or below the mean
